+"""Generate the fixed-instance Rubik's cube stacking trajectory."""
+from pathlib import Path
+import json
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_robolab import Session, quat_to_mat
+
+OUT = Path('/app/output')
+
+
+def bounds(s, name):
+    return np.asarray(s.object_bounds(name), dtype=float)
+
+
+def center(s, name):
+    return bounds(s, name).mean(axis=0)
+
+
+def grasp_quat(s, name):
+    p = s.primitives()
+    rotation = quat_to_mat(s.object_pose(name)[1])
+    horizontal = [rotation[:, i] for i in range(3) if abs(rotation[2, i]) < 0.2]
+    yaws = [p['yaw_for_closing_dir'](v[:2]) for v in horizontal]
+    return p['top_down_quat'](min(yaws, key=abs))
+
+
+def report(s, stage):
+    print(stage, json.dumps({'status': s.status(), 'objects': s.objects(),
+                             'tcp': s.ee_pose()[0].tolist()}), flush=True)
+
+
+def pick(s, name):
+    p = s.primitives()
+    q = grasp_quat(s, name)
+    p['open_gripper'](15)
+    c = center(s, name)
+    p['move_ee']([c[0], c[1], 0.20], q, speed=0.16, tol=0.002, settle=3)
+    c = center(s, name)
+    z = bounds(s, name)[0, 2] + 0.009
+    p['move_ee']([c[0], c[1], z], q, speed=0.065, tol=0.0015, settle=5)
+    p['close_gripper'](22)
+    report(s, 'grasped ' + name)
+    tcp = s.ee_pose()[0]
+    p['move_ee']([tcp[0], tcp[1], 0.22], q, speed=0.08, tol=0.002, settle=5)
+    report(s, 'lifted ' + name)
+    if bounds(s, name)[0, 2] < 0.12:
+        raise RuntimeError('Cube did not lift: ' + name)
+    return q
+
+
+def place_on(s, name, support, q):
+    p = s.primitives()
+    tcp = s.ee_pose()[0]
+    offset = tcp[:2] - center(s, name)[:2]
+    destination = center(s, support)[:2] + offset
+    p['move_ee']([*destination, 0.23], q, speed=0.12, tol=0.0015, settle=4)
+    # Re-measure the held cube after transport, including any slip in the pads.
+    tcp = s.ee_pose()[0]
+    b = bounds(s, name)
+    destination = center(s, support)[:2] + tcp[:2] - b.mean(axis=0)[:2]
+    z = bounds(s, support)[1, 2] + (tcp[2] - b[0, 2]) + 0.003
+    p['move_ee']([*destination, z + 0.035], q, speed=0.07, tol=0.0015, settle=3)
+    p['move_ee']([*destination, z], q, speed=0.025, tol=0.001, settle=3)
+    p['open_gripper'](18)
+    report(s, 'placed ' + name)
+    if not s.episode_done:
+        tcp = s.ee_pose()[0]
+        p['move_ee']([tcp[0], tcp[1], 0.23], q, speed=0.08, tol=0.002, settle=10)
+
+
+def generate(s):
+    s.record_start()
+    try:
+        q = pick(s, 'rubiks_cube_2')
+        place_on(s, 'rubiks_cube_2', 'rubiks_cube', q)
+        q = pick(s, 'rubiks_cube_1')
+        place_on(s, 'rubiks_cube_1', 'rubiks_cube_2', q)
+    finally:
+        actions = s.record_stop()
+        path = OUT / ('trajectory.npz' if s.status()['success'] else 'attempt.npz')
+        s.save_trajectory(actions, str(path))
+        print('SAVED', str(path), len(actions), s.status(), flush=True)
+    return actions
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    session = Session('stack3_rubiks_cube', instance='/app/instance.json')
+    generate(session)
+    session.close()
*** End Patch"));
